priceArithmetic: Raw source quotes remain unchanged; price MA/5percent/15percent/range-position comparisons use integer cent numerators to avoid binary boundary drift
purpose: Test a whole daily executable system inspired by all closed source trades, including failures; never transplant the source trader payoff into a new strategy.

market.admission: Inherited observed SH/SZ close>MA60, MA20>MA60 on both indices; observed cohort breadth60>0.5 with>=95percent coverage; SH/SZ turnover>=1trillion yuan and mean5/priorMean20>=0.8
market.green: admitted and turnover ratio>=1: gross entry budget60percent, single stock20percent, one position stop-risk0.5percent equity
market.yellow: admitted and ratio<1: gross entry budget30percent, single stock10percent, one position stop-risk0.25percent equity
market.off: no new entries; queue all held positions for next open exit
market.exposureReduction: At each close queue whole positions with weakest close/entry return first until unqueued market value<=state gross cap; outstanding forced exits are retained, not cancelled on recovery
market.proxy: TDX broad SH/SZ turnover and survivor cohort breadth, not an official all-A-share complete census

sector.membership: CAPCO historical industry cohorts strictly after source publication date, same published snapshot for each decision; historical themes unavailable
sector.known: At least5 members and95percent aligned coverage for each return5/20, MA20 breadth and amount ratio
sector.strong: return5>0, relative20 versus CSI300>0, breadth20>0.5 and matched mean5/priorMean20 turnover ratio divided by market ratio>=1
sector.rotation: Top3 strong sectors by equal midrank scores of relative5, relative20 and relative turnover participation; recompute daily. Never sell solely for dropping out of top3
sector.holdingHealth: relative20>0 and breadth20>0.5; two consecutive known failures trigger next-open exit; unknown interrupts count, membership publication change resets count
sector.allocation: Sector maximum40percent equity; at most one new candidate per sector per close; maintain cash if no qualified candidate

stock.common: Exactly22 continuous price-valid positive OHLCV/amount source slots, no explicit suspension; prior20 mean amount>=50million yuan; positive true-range fraction<1; actual stock trading-status/lot/limit gates inherited
stock.A_ignition: Previous close20-return<=15percent; current close breaks prior20 highest high and yesterday did not; current one-day return>=5percent, amount>=1.5*prior20 mean, close lies in top quarter of daily range. No claim to intraday first-board fill
stock.B_corePullback: Previous close positive20-return, industry20-return midrank>=0.8 and previous close>previous MA10; current return<0, current low<=previous MA5, current close>=current MA10, close in top half daily range and amount>=0.5*prior20 mean. Next-open version of confirmed pullback, not intraday dip replication
stock.ranking: Per sector A before B; then descending previous industry20 midrank, prior20 amount, symbol; sectors by score then sectorCode; max5 planned candidates per close
stock.structuralFloor: max(0.95*signalClose, min(minimum low of signal session and prior2 sessions,0.99*signalClose)); retained as entry-price ratio for inherited reference conversion

positions.sizing: Minimum of state single-stock cap, gross cap headroom,40percent sector headroom, actual unreserved cash, state stop-risk divided by stop distance; fee-inclusive affordable round lot
positions.opening: Only next independent session, no retries/backfill/additions. Reject open<=signal structural floor or open>signalClose*(1+min(meanNtr20,0.03)); recompute risk and gross/sector room using observable open and fees, never enlarge reserved quantity
positions.debt: Unleveraged cash account; no averaging down, no pyramiding in v1
positions.capacity: Inherited prior-session-volume participation ceiling1percent is a proxy; opening-auction capacity not certified

exit.priority: Persistent prior exit; inherited eligibility/5percent close stop/10session time exit; structural floor; entry-session no-follow-through; second-session no-progress; profit trail; sector health; market exposure
exit.failedEntry: Entry-session close<=actual entry fill queues next-open exit; from second session close gain<2percent queues next-open exit
exit.winner: No fixed take-profit. Once close peak>=entry*1.06, ratchet a close-time floor at peak*(1-max(0.03,min(0.08,1.5*signalMeanNtr20))); only increases in entry-price ratio units
exit.execution: Every trigger is known after close, fills earliest next tradable open with T+1, price-limit/suspension/lot/cash gates and persistent blocked sell retries.5percent is a price trigger, never a promised maximum realized loss

evaluation.fees: Inherited explicit commission0.03percent min5yuan, transfer0.001percent, dated sell stamp duty, adverse slippage10bps each side; cost stress35bps each side with all gates rerun
unknowns: Repeatedly exposed historical data, no pristine holdout
Raw-price and surviving universe source limits
Incomplete dated status and available-rights source
Industry rotation proxy, not historical thematic rotation
No minute or opening queue capacity evidence
